name: s17-mine-star-op0-p1
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo && mkdir -p s17 && cp s17data/family.json s17/family.json && (cd . && mkdir -p prof && GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=3 GDP_COUNTS_DUMP_ALL_PASSES=1 timeout -s TERM -k 10 300 research/track-wall/s17-trace.ts s17/family.json star 0 1 60000 > trace.out 2> trace.err; echo EXIT $?; grep 'S17_END' trace.out; grep 'counts: try' trace.err | cut -c1-300; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | cut -c1-6000; echo PHASES; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | grep -o '"phase":"[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head; )
